findings.evidence: `gradedPiece`, `gradedPiece_induction`, and `mem_gradedPiece_of_tprod` are defined at `GradedCoderivation.lean:298–329`, while the new general results occur at `OddSquare.lean:63`, `:99`, and `:143` and accept arbitrary degrees/parameters.
findings.fix: Move these declarations and their private helper into `TensorCoalgebra/GradedCoderivation.lean` beside `gradedPiece` and its induction API; keep only the degree-one anticommutation and square results in `OddSquare.lean`.
findings.issue: `iSup_gradedPiece_eq_top`, `map_koszulTwist_apply_of_mem`, and `LinearMap.IsHomogeneous.map_koszulTwist_comp` are general properties of `gradedPiece` and the letterwise twist, unrelated to the degree-one square specialization.

summary: General total-grading and twist lemmas are placed in the specialized odd-square module instead of beside the grading API they elaborate.
